fields.label: Project Title (과제명)
fields.value: IATHEON & HEBE: Open Evidence-Unit & Structure-Grounded Dry-Lab Desks for Targeted Cancer Therapy Resistance and Metabolic/Alopecia Biology

fields.label: Team Description (<100w)
fields.value: Byungchul Lee is Founder and Principal Investigator of RISCON Labs, an independent research organization operating 16 open scientific and decision-auditing desks (including IATHEON for oncology resistance and HEBE for metabolic/alopecia biology) backed by a 26,000-agent verification pipeline (HALLUC-GATE).

fields.label: Research Project Description (<500w)
fields.value: Targeted cancer therapies in gastric and breast cancer (HER2, Claudin 18.2, FGFR2b, TROP2, PI3K/AKT, CDK4/6) and metabolic/alopecia interventions (GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists, AR/Wnt signaling) generate fragmented clinical trial outcomes, resistance mutation profiles, and 3D protein structure models. Researchers struggle to audit where preclinical or computational structure claims end and verified human clinical evidence begins. RISCON Labs operates IATHEON (https://iatheon.risconlabs.com) and HEBE (https://hebe.risconlabs.com), two open dry-lab research desks that decompose published clinical trials (NCT IDs, PubMed/PMC full texts) and AlphaFold/PDB 3D biomolecular structures into falsifiable Evidence Units. Every claim is tagged by evidence tier (Clinical, Preclinical, Literature, Computational) with explicit revision triggers and verified via our mechanical HALLUC-GATE auditor (https://hallucgate.risconlabs.com).

fields.label: How Claude Capabilities Will Be Used (<200w)
fields.value: We use Claude models to perform multi-document synthesis across oncology phase I-III trial updates, extract resistance mutation pathways against PDB/AlphaFold binding pockets, and formulate explicit falsification conditions for each therapeutic question while enforcing zero-hallucination citation anchoring.

fields.label: Potential Scientific Impact (<200w)
fields.value: By strictly separating computational structure predictions from clinical outcomes and attaching explicit revision conditions to every oncology and metabolic research synthesis, IATHEON and HEBE provide an open, zero-paywall evidence standard for translational researchers and clinical trialists worldwide.

fields.label: Specific Success Metrics (<100w)
fields.value: Expand IATHEON and HEBE from 60+ to 500+ source-anchored oncology/metabolic evidence units over 6 months, maintaining 0.0% soft-null/citation defects under mechanical HALLUC-GATE verification.

fields.value: $20,000 in Claude API credits over 6 months

fields.value: Byungchul Lee leads RISCON Labs, an AI safety and decision-auditing research institute operating 16 public evaluation platforms (including ASI 2030, ARCHON, NADIR, PRO SE, and HALLUC-GATE) and training human ASI auditors across the L0-L6 verification ladder.

fields.label: Research Description (<300w)
fields.value: We investigate two failure modes in high-volume frontier-to-batch distillation: (1) Soft-Null Evasion, where models copy input text verbatim (fix == original) or hallucinate unanchored source quotes under strict correction rubrics; and (2) Sycophantic Frame Amplification across organizational failure (NADIR, 5,863 cases) and self-represented litigation (PRO SE). Using Claude as the high-precision L3 Challenger and L5 Auditor reference model, we benchmark automated detection rates against our mechanical HALLUC-GATE filter (https://hallucgate.risconlabs.com) and publish all evaluation datasets openly.
